text:
Leah Kim: quick note from a support case — customer quoted our audit-logs page saying we provide "physical per-tenant siloing". that wording is risky for SOC2 and enterprise contracts. can we update the docs and the SDK examples to be explicit about logical tagging + access controls?

Jonas Becker: ugh, thanks for flagging. which snippet is that? JS or Go?

Leah Kim: both — search results show the phrase in `docs/security/audit-logs.md` and in the JS snippet under /examples/sdk/export-audit.js

Priya Nair: i can open a docs PR. preferred replacement language suggestion?

Marco Ruiz (Legal): please use conservative language. suggested: "Audit events include tenant identifiers; access and export are controlled by RBAC and platform policies. This does not imply physically segregated storage unless explicitly purchased via Private deployments." Also add a SOC2-aligned sentence: "Customers should ensure retention configurations meet their contractual and regulatory obligations."

Jonas Becker: for SDK snippets i propose showing a filter + export call to make it clear it's an access/export flow. JS example:

```js
// query with tenant filter, then explicitly export results
const events = await client.queryAuditEvents({ filter: { tenant_id: 'tenant_abc' } });
await client.exportEvents(events, { destination: 's3://your-bucket/tenant_abc' });
```

Leah Kim: nice and concise. can we also change any UI wording that says "siloing" or "isolated" to avoid ambiguity?

Priya Nair: yes. i'll add a short migration note in /docs/migration/security-audit-phrasing.md explaining the change and linking to Private deployments for customers needing physical isolation. also will update the examples in JS + Go and the prose on audit-logs.md.

Marco Ruiz (Legal): approved the new phrasing as long as we don't list retention durations or say "we will store separately". keep it high level.

Jonas Becker: adding Go snippet too:

```go
// tenant-filtered query then explicit export step
events, _ := client.QueryAuditEvents(ctx, QueryFilter{TenantID: "tenant_abc"})
client.ExportEvents(ctx, events, ExportOptions{Destination: "s3://your-bucket/tenant_abc"})
```

Leah Kim: minor nit — replace `tenant_abc` with `your-tenant-id` in examples per style guide.

Priya Nair: good catch. also swapping the placeholder bucket name to `your-bucket` per legal. will do in the PR.

Leah Kim: can someone grep the repo for the phrase "silo" or "isolat" to catch other occurrences?

Jonas Becker: running grep now, will open follow-ups for hits.

DocsBot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4342 (checks: running) :sparkles:

Priya Nair: i'll request review from Marco and merge after legal sign-off and CI. adding a tiny unit test in the docs linter to fail on the banned phrase list ("silo","physically isolated","tenant-segregated").

Marco Ruiz (Legal): added comments on the PR: please include the SOC2-safe line exactly as: "Ensure retention configurations meet contractual and regulatory obligations." Once that's in i can formally approve.

Jonas Becker: grep turned up 3 other files; i've opened three small PRs to replace wording and point to the migration note.

DocsBot: CI passed for PR 4342, pending Marco Ruiz review.

Marco Ruiz (Legal): reviewed and approved. wording looks good. approved on GH.

DocsBot: PR 4342 merged by Priya Nair — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4342 :white_check_mark:

Leah Kim: resolved. thanks everyone. follow-ups for the other 3 files are linked in the thread.

Priya Nair: created a short doc task to audit other security pages for ambiguous language next sprint. will include the linter rule so this won't regress.

Jonas Becker: thanks — will monitor linter alerts and update SDK example tests accordingly. :thumbsup:
